description: Read a web page and return its main readable content as clean text (not HTML). Managed operation: call with op:start; a bounded result containing the URL, title, excerpt, text, length, and truncation status arrives later as an operation_result. Do not expect the result in the same turn.

op.description: Operation to perform. 'start' fetches and finishes immediately. 'poll' is never needed in practice (start always finishes) but exists to satisfy the managed-operation contract.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL to read. Required with op:start.

handle.description: Only used with op:poll. Ignored otherwise.
